title: Proposal to Allow Persons under 18 to Access Counselling or Screening without Parental Consent
what_it_is: Proposal to Allow Persons under 18 to Access Counselling or Screening without Parental Consent

sections.label: MOH expert group mental health guidelines
sections.summary: MOH convened an expert group to study parental consent for lower-level intervention and develop guidelines, with details when ready early next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) has convened an expert group to study this issue and develop guidelines on the subject.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One of the key issues we need to examine is whether for lower-level intervention that involves mostly befriending and emotional support, no parental consent may be required.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: However, if the objective is to encourage youths to step forward to seek help with their mental health challenges, this will need to be coupled with more proactive engagement and outreach to those who may need help.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will provide more details when the guidelines are ready early next year.

sections.label: Timeline for stakeholder consultation framework
sections.summary: The work of consulting stakeholders and putting up a framework or guidelines will hopefully conclude by early next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of timeline, we will try to conclude the work of consulting with stakeholders and put up some framework or guidelines, hopefully, by early next year.

sections.label: Gradually involving parents in child counselling
sections.summary: Social service agencies should be sensitive to child and parent needs, involving parents gradually along the process as counsellors assess.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Because when this is being adopted, then this will ensure higher accessibility to mental health services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But what we want is to provide some guidance so that the social service agencies can be sensitive to the needs of both the child and the parents, and as good practice, to involve the parents sometime along the journey.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Perhaps not right at the beginning, if it feels that it is quite sensitive for the child to even approach them for some assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But somewhere along the way, after a few consultations with the child, when the child has developed more confidence in the process and counsellor assesses that it is the right time to bring the parents into that recovery effort, then I think that is where the sensitivity needs to be applied and involve the parents gradually along the process and reconcile any challenges that the child may have with the parents if that is indeed the source where the mental stress is for the children.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And I think this is a process where we need to rely on the expertise and experience of the counsellors to do this with sensitivity.
